title: Drunk Man Harasses Deputies Then Gets Himself Arrested
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 28th, 2023. A drunk driver nearly collided with deputies on the road. The drunk driver was arrested however his friend became extremely belligerent and kept harassing deputies for arresting his friend who was drunk driving. He was also harassing the deputy because his phone died and needed a ride home because he was also drunk. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
